purpose: Teach: 位相/流体/研磨/僻地/共振/界面/発振/電極

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、量子力学の位相情報の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered quantum mechanics and phase information in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Opens with his name like a gentle confirmation, not a quiz. Steady, observant tone — she's noticed the work. Easy pace, inviting him to settle into the moment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、流体力学の翼設計研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about fluid dynamics and wing design optimization.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Slight hesitation before the topic — gathering his thoughts without rushing. Quiet conviction in the words. Direct eye contact energy but not loud.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、半導体の研磨技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And semiconductor polishing techniques came up in your research too, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. She's working through something — testing a thread. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to help her understand. Warm but not leading.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、僻地医療の課題研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually I focused on rural healthcare challenges and accessibility issues.
lines.style: Quiet correction. He's shifting gears calmly, redirecting her thread without making her feel wrong. Patient. Small breath before the topic — this one matters to him a little more.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 構造物の共振現象を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Structural resonance phenomena — that was important to your work, wasn't it?
lines.style: Engaged but not pushing. She's connecting dots aloud, inviting him into the thinking. Lighter tone than before — she's enjoying this. Natural curiosity, no agenda.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、化学の界面活性剤研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I also researched surfactant chemistry and interface phenomena.
lines.style: Consistent, measured. He's keeping pace with her gentle questions. No defensiveness. Simple confidence in what he's done. Breath steady throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、発振回路の設計研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Oscillating circuits — you studied circuit design there as well, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. She's thinking as she speaks. Slight tilt of recognition in her voice. Steady but softer — she's settling into the portrait of his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、電池の電極材料研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my most recent work was on battery electrode materials and performance optimization.
lines.style: Clear closure. He answers fully, with quiet finality. Pride underneath but not displayed. A small pause after 'yes' — this piece of work he's proud of. Breath settles at the end.
